response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS average_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_amount FROM account_averages) SELECT a.account_id, a.average_amount, a.average_amount - m.mean_amount AS above_mean FROM account_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE a.average_amount > m.mean_amount ORDER BY above_mean DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10
